about: The Assistant's app tools (AppTools) on one snapshot of the app. Times are local: 'at' is 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm'. The timetable uses the standard 12 periods. Vocabulary: cards are the replay of the events with the default FSRS parameters; an event's study day is its date, answered at its time; the plan and countdown are for 'now'. For each call (tool name + the model's JSON arguments), validate the arguments, then expect: 'result' (a reading tool's text), 'error' (the text of an error result) or 'proposal' (a change: add/update {title, date, timing: anytime | at HH:mm | after <course id>, done}, delete <todo id>, courses {courses, duplicates, problems}, focus {goal, totalMinutes, usesBreaks}). 'running' adds a focus session running 10:00-11:00 today ('英语阅读'); 'signedOut' leaves the vocabulary out.
